synth.notes:
Mechanic the committee missed: every piece block not on the axis row is mirrored to block row 2A-b, including blocks BELOW the axis. At step 71 the axis moves up through a piece, so the piece's bottom row reflects upward (reflection_0 at 39,36), and the walls stay split around the piece and targets.
Model: axis row A (21 blocks, centre 0 when selected), pieces as block sets (layer 4), static targets, derived reflections (clipped, never drawn on piece blocks).
A1/A2/A3/A4 move the selection by -/+1 block row or column; the axis ignores A3/A4 and passes under pieces; a piece is stopped by the board edges and by other pieces; A5 cycles axis -> pieces (sorted by min block) -> axis.
Rendering: cell stacks piece>reflection>target>wall; the first solid pixel wins, otherwise the topmost hole fill. Objects are re-extracted as 4-connected components; wall and player names rank by bbox (x,y) including 0-only components, which are not output.
Not confirmed: piece cycle order past the first piece,
